'''Juris Sector Forces''' was a [[Planetary Security Forces|planetary security force]] that loaned four [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]] for its upcoming [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|attack]] on the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Echo Base/Legends|base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
